_comment: chdb-core is the engine repository behind libchdb (https://github.com/chdb-io/chdb-core), versioned independently of the Python-facing chdb-io/chdb release train; v26.7.0 is the engine pin chdb-io/chdb-go's own update_libchdb.sh (CHDB_ENGINE_PIN) carries as of this issue, chosen for that external cross-check rather than picked arbitrarily. Each platform's tarball ships libchdb.so plus its own chdb.h/chdb.hpp C/C++ API headers at that exact build, so fetch-chdb.mjs vendors all three from the one pinned, checksummed asset instead of sourcing the header from a second, independently-versioned repository. Only linux-x86_64 is pinned today — the only platform the chdb-differential CI lane (ubuntu-latest) runs on; a future lane on another platform adds its own entry here rather than guessing at a checksum.
